caseNameFull: Cotten v. Schlesinger, Secretary of Defense

opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. Motion of Americans for Middle East Neutrality for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae denied. Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion. Certiorari denied. Mr. Justice Douglas would grant certiorari. Reported below: 506 F. 2d 1397.
